instruction: Grab the rubikscube with yellow top and place it right of the smooth brown coffee-box.

source.instruction: Grab the rubikscube with yellow top and place it right of the smooth brown coffee-box.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the object, which was at x = +14 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper to (14, -18, 94) above the cube and orient it downwards.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-17, +1, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (14, -18, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm partially toward the cube to z = 86.5 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (14, -18, 87) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper to grasp height z = 77 cm and close gripper.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object; closed the gripper (opening 0.63: holding the object)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (14, -18, 78) opening 0.63; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift right arm with the cube to z = 87 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (14, -18, 87) opening 0.64; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move cube to (13.5, -1, 87.5) to position it right of the coffee-box.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-1, +17, +1) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (13, -1, 88) opening 0.64; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm slightly before releasing.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (13, -1, 88) opening 0.64; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower cube to table surface at z = 80 cm and open gripper to release.
